_comment: Links for the app flyer. Leave a value null until the real link exists — the flyer then prints a labelled placeholder slot and a DRAFT watermark instead of a QR that goes nowhere. Fill in, re-run tools/marketing/build_app_flyer.py, re-print.
_android_note: android_url MUST stay the short redirect path, never a release asset URL: the APK tag moves every build and the flyer is printed. The redirect lives in the info-site repo (next.config.ts) and is covered by a test there.
_badge_note: Official Apple artwork, unmodified: fetched from toolbox.marketingtools.apple.com (black, en-us) as SVG and rasterised to PNG at 600 px high with rsvg-convert. Aspect preserved exactly (2.9917 vs 2.9916). Never recolour, angle or redraw it. The SVG source sits beside the PNG.
